params.prompt: Extreme close-up, 100 mm macro lens at f/2, camera fixed at pillow height with the lens axis parallel to the pillow. The sleeping face of the girl from the reference sheet, the same hand-painted low-poly character: warm brown skin, big closed eyelids with thick dark lashes, round cheeks, voluminous dark curly hair. She lies on her left side, so her face is horizontal in the frame, forehead toward the right and chin toward the left, her left cheek sunk into a cream pillow, a few curls fallen over her temple and the collar of a khaki shirt over a dark T-shirt at the edge of the frame. Eyes closed, calm, mouth relaxed. A razor-thin plane of focus lies on the lashes of her upper eye; her lower eye and the far curls fall softly out of focus. The lashes and the inner corner of that eye are slightly wet, with no visible teardrop. The inner corner of her upper eye sits slightly above and to the right of the centre of the frame. It is just before dawn: the only light is faint cool skylight from a window above her head, a thin cool edge along the bridge of her nose and the lashes; the whole face is in deep petrol-blue shadow, the darkest tones warm and never pure black, and there is no warm light anywhere yet. The background melts into a soft dark blur. Art style: stylized low-poly 3D exactly like the reference images, crisp faceted flat-shaded planes with a hand-painted gradient on each facet, cel-shaded lighting with a bright rim light, chunky simplified forms, clean readable silhouettes, matte materials, palette of cream, terracotta, tropical green, petrol blue and warm wood browns, with cyan reserved for technology, data and collectibles. Clean image without film grain. No text, no logos, no insignia, no emblems, no watermark.
